ℹ️ Usage Information

Data Privacy: Your analysis data is sent to the AI service for interpretation. No data is stored by the AI service beyond the request.

Costs: AI API usage may incur costs based on your service provider's pricing.

Offline Mode: If no API is configured, the system will show a configuration prompt.
